irUnavailable: اس ڈیوائس پر IR Blaster دستیاب نہیں ہے۔
smartDiscoveryFailed: اسمارٹ ڈیوائسز دریافت نہیں ہو سکیں۔
irTabWarning: IR tab available hai lekin is phone me IR hardware nahi hai. Detail dekhne ke liye IR tab open karein.
irUnavailableTitle: Is device par IR mode unavailable hai
irIssueReason: Wajah: Is phone me Consumer IR emitter detect nahi hua, is liye direct IR signal send nahi ho sakta.
howToUseIrTitle: IR mode use karne ka tareeqa
irInstructionStep1: Step 1: Built-in IR blaster wala Android phone use karein.
irInstructionStep2: Step 2: TV/AC brand select karein, phir pehle power aur volume test karein.
irInstructionStep3: Step 3: Agar IR unavailable ho to Smart Devices tab same WiFi par use karein.
smartGuideStep1: Step 1: Phone aur TV/AC ko same WiFi network par rakhein.
smartGuideStep2: Step 2: Retry dabakar rescan karein, phir device tap karke pair karein.
smartGuideStep3: Step 3: Pairing ke baad controls use karein aur TV par YouTube/Navigation test karein.
universalGuideStep1: Universal mode me TV aur AC ke quick controls aik jagah milte hain.
universalGuideStep2: Agar IR supported ho to command IR se jati hai, warna smart-device fallback use hota hai.
universalGuideStep3: Best practice: pehle Smart tab me devices pair karein, phir daily use ke liye Universal chalayein.
